title: Positive Testing - LTE/5G NSA Single UE Attach and Detach Procedure Validation
preconditions: Single cell environment with no inter-cell interference
Stationary UE (real or emulated) placed under excellent radio conditions (LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP)
All other cells powered off
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup according to test configuration and activate serving cell
Place UE under excellent radio conditions near radiated eNB/gNB antenna
Start log capturing for call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure to LTE or 5G NSA cell
Wait and verify successful attach completion
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure
Wait and verify successful detach completion
Stop and save logs for analysis
Repeat attach and detach procedure 10 times consecutively
expectedResults: All 10 attach attempts succeed with 100% attach success rate
All 10 detach attempts succeed with 100% detach success rate
Attach latency metrics (min, average, max) captured and within expected limits
UE attached to correct cell as per PCI, Global eNB/gNB ID, and ARFCN/NR-ARFCN
Detach procedure validated via UE context release and RRC connection release messages in logs
verificationMethods: Analyze test logs for attach request and attach complete messages per iteration
Analyze test logs for detach request and detach accept messages per iteration
Validate UE cell identity in logs matches expected configuration
Calculate and record attach latency metrics
Confirm 10 consecutive successful attach-detach cycles

title: Negative Testing - Attach/Detach Failure Scenarios with Single UE
preconditions: Test setup as per standard single cell scenario
UE placed under degraded radio conditions (below excellent RSRP/SS-RSRP thresholds)
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup and activate serving cell
Place UE under marginal or poor radio conditions to simulate weak signal
Start log capturing
Power ON UE to initiate attach procedure
Observe and record any attach failures or timeouts
Power OFF UE to initiate detach procedure if attach succeeded
Observe and record any detach failures or timeouts
Stop and save logs
Repeat procedure for at least 10 iterations
expectedResults: Attach or detach procedure may fail due to poor radio conditions
Failures should be logged with appropriate error messages
System should recover gracefully without crashes or indefinite hangs
Attach and detach success rates are below 100% as expected
Attach latency, if attach succeeds, may increase significantly
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach/detach failure messages
Check system stability and recovery after failures
Record attach and detach success rates and compare to baseline
Measure attach latency for successful attempts

title: Edge Case Testing - Minimum Coupling Loss Boundary for UE Placement
preconditions: Test setup with variable attenuator or fading generator available
Single cell environment with stationary UE
Ability to measure LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP
testSteps: Configure test setup and activate serving cell
Gradually increase attenuator to approach minimum coupling loss limit as defined in Clause 4.6
At each step, measure UE radio conditions (RSRP or SS-RSRP)
Place UE exactly at or just inside the minimum coupling loss limit ensuring excellent radio conditions
Start log capturing
Power ON UE to initiate attach procedure
Verify successful attach
Power OFF UE to initiate detach procedure
Verify successful detach
Repeat for 10 iterations
Repeat test placing UE just outside minimum coupling loss limit (slightly worse radio)
Observe attach/detach success and latency
expectedResults: At minimum coupling loss boundary or better, attach and detach succeed with 100% success rate
Just outside minimum coupling loss boundary, attach/detach may fail or latency may increase
Radio parameters (RSRP/SS-RSRP) recorded at each attenuation step
System behavior at boundary conditions documented
verificationMethods: Measure and log radio parameters at each attenuation step
Analyze logs for attach/detach success/failure and latency
Verify compliance with minimum coupling loss requirements

title: Performance Testing - Attach/Detach Latency Measurement Under Load
preconditions: Single cell environment with capability to simulate multiple UEs
Stationary UE under excellent radio conditions for primary test UE
Load generator or multiple emulated UEs available
testSteps: Configure test setup and activate serving cell
Place primary UE under excellent radio conditions
Simultaneously activate multiple additional UEs to simulate load
Start log capturing on primary UE
Power ON primary UE to initiate attach
Measure attach latency
Power OFF primary UE to initiate detach
Measure detach success and latency
Repeat attach-detach procedure 10 times consecutively
Record attach/detach success rates and latency statistics under load
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain at or near 100% under load
Attach latency remains within acceptable limits with minor impact from load
No loss of signaling messages or connectivity issues observed
System remains stable under load
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach/detach signaling messages under load
Calculate latency metrics and compare against baseline without load
Monitor system resource usage and stability during test

title: Security Testing - Attach/Detach with Unauthorized UE and Access Control Verification
preconditions: Test setup with access control policies enforced
UE identity to be tested is unauthorized or blacklisted
Serving cell activated and configured
testSteps: Configure test setup with access control policy denying specific UE identity
Place unauthorized UE under excellent radio conditions
Start log capturing
Power ON unauthorized UE to initiate attach
Observe attach rejection or failure messages
Attempt detach if attach unexpectedly succeeds
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Unauthorized UE attach attempts are rejected with proper cause codes
Detach procedure not applicable or succeeds if attach erroneously succeeds
System logs access control enforcement events
No security breaches or unauthorized access granted
verificationMethods: Analyze attach reject messages and cause codes in logs
Verify access control enforcement in system logs
Confirm no unauthorized UE context established

title: Integration Testing - 5G NSA EN-DC Secondary Node Addition and Release Procedure Validation
preconditions: 5G NSA dual connectivity setup with MN and SN configured
Single UE under excellent radio conditions
Serving cell activated and unloaded
testSteps: Configure test setup for 5G NSA with EN-DC enabled
Place UE under excellent radio conditions near eNB/gNB antennas
Start log capturing
Power ON UE to initiate LTE attach and EN-DC secondary node addition
Validate attach request and attach complete messages
Validate SgNB addition request and reconfiguration complete messages
Power OFF UE to initiate detach and secondary node release
Validate detach request and detach accept messages
Validate Secondary Node Release message flows as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
Repeat attach-detach with secondary node addition-release for 10 iterations
expectedResults: Attach and secondary node addition success rates are 100%
Detach and secondary node release success rates are 100%
SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge messages exchanged correctly
RRCConnectionReconfiguration message correctly indicates SCG release
Logs confirm release of UE context at SN and resource cleanup
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for LTE attach and EN-DC signaling flows
Validate secondary node addition and release messages per 3GPP specs
Confirm 10 consecutive successful cycles
Verify UE context release and resource cleanup at SN

title: Usability Testing - Clarity and Simplicity of Single UE Attach/Detach Test Procedure
preconditions: Test procedure documentation available
Test engineers with varying experience levels
testSteps: Provide test procedure documentation to test engineers
Ask engineers to set up and execute the single UE attach/detach test independently
Collect feedback on clarity, completeness, and ease of understanding
Identify any ambiguous or missing steps
Measure time taken to prepare and execute test
Evaluate ease of logging and KPI recording
expectedResults: Test procedure is clear and complete for engineers of all experience levels
No major ambiguities or missing steps reported
Test execution time is reasonable and consistent
Logging and KPI capture instructions are understandable and actionable
verificationMethods: Collect and analyze qualitative feedback from test engineers
Review test reports for completeness and accuracy
Assess time and resource efficiency during test execution

title: Compatibility Testing - LTE and 5G NSA Attach and Detach Across Different UE Types and Environments
preconditions: Test setup supports LTE and 5G NSA modes
Multiple UE types (real and emulated) available
Test environments: laboratory with RF shielded box and field environment
testSteps: Configure test setup for LTE attach/detach with real UE in lab environment
Place UE under excellent radio conditions
Perform 10 attach-detach iterations recording KPIs
Repeat test with emulated UE in lab environment
Configure test setup for 5G NSA attach/detach with real UE in field environment
Place UE at cell center near antenna
Perform 10 attach-detach iterations recording KPIs
Repeat test with emulated UE in field environment
Compare results across UE types and environments
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100% across UE types and environments
Attach latency and other KPIs are within acceptable ranges and consistent
No unexpected failures or incompatibilities observed
Test configuration parameters properly recorded for all scenarios
verificationMethods: Analyze logs and KPI tables for each environment and UE type
Compare KPI metrics across tests for consistency
Check for any environment or UE-specific anomalies

title: Registration Test - 5G NSA Registration Request to Registration Complete
preconditions: 5G NSA capable UE and network setup
Serving cell activated and unloaded
UE under excellent radio conditions
testSteps: Place UE under excellent radio conditions
Start log capturing for registration signaling
Power ON UE to initiate registration procedure
Verify UE sends Registration Request message to network
Network responds with Registration Accept message
UE sends Registration Complete message
Stop log capturing
Repeat registration procedure 10 times
expectedResults: Registration Request, Accept, and Complete messages exchanged successfully each iteration
UE successfully registered on 5G NSA network
No registration failures or rejections observed
Logs confirm correct message sequence and timing
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for presence and correctness of Registration Request, Accept, and Complete messages
Verify UE registration status in network management system
Confirm 10 consecutive successful registrations

title: PDU Session Test - 5G NSA PDU Session Establishment with Authentication and User Plane Setup
preconditions: 5G NSA capable UE and network setup with SMF and UPF configured
Serving cell activated and unloaded
UE under excellent radio conditions and registered
testSteps: Initiate PDU Session Establishment Request from UE
Verify network performs PDU Session Authentication if applicable
Observe network sends PDU Session Accept message
Verify User Plane setup including N3 Tunnel Creation
Monitor related signaling messages for SMF, UPF, N11, and N4 interfaces
Confirm QoS Flow establishment
Perform PDU Session Release and verify signaling
Repeat PDU Session establishment and release at least 5 times
expectedResults: PDU Session Establishment Request, Authentication, and Accept messages exchanged successfully
User Plane paths including N3 Tunnel correctly established
QoS Flows configured as per policy
PDU Session Release completed correctly
No errors or failures in signaling or data path setup
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for PDU session signaling messages
Verify user plane tunnel establishment in network elements
Confirm QoS parameters in session management
Check for absence of errors in session setup and release

title: Handover Test - 5G NSA Xn Handover Procedure Validation
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with source and target gNBs connected via Xn interface
Single UE under excellent radio conditions in source cell
UE attached and registered
testSteps: Configure UE measurement reporting to trigger handover
UE sends Measurement Report indicating need for handover
Source gNB sends Handover Required message to target gNB
Target gNB responds with Handover Request message
Source gNB receives Handover Request Acknowledge
Source gNB sends RRC Reconfiguration message to UE
UE performs handover and connects to target gNB
Target gNB initiates Path Switch procedure
UE sends Handover Complete message
Monitor and verify all signaling messages and successful handover completion
expectedResults: All handover signaling messages exchanged successfully and in sequence
UE successfully hands over from source to target gNB without data loss
Path switch completed and UE context updated
No failure or fallback during handover
Logs confirm measurement report triggered handover and completion
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for Measurement Report, Handover Required, Request, Ack, RRC Reconfiguration, Path Switch, and Handover Complete messages
Verify UE context handover in network management
Check data continuity during handover
